name: 【价值投资】-公司深度分析
description_zh: 二级市场买方视角深度分析 Skill。当用户要求对某只股票进行深度分析、价值分析、基本面分析时使用此 skill。核心能力：(1) 先执行财务筛查，不满足条件直接终止；(2) 通过筛查后，依次分析生意是什么、增长潜力、商业模式、竞争壁垒、企业文化、组织力、管理层再投资（再投资回报与资本配置纪律）；(3) 最后以反向劝退视角系统梳理所有投资风险。强调证据原则：只有被直接证据支持的内容才写成确定性陈述，每段分析后必须罗列证据与出处。适用于 A 股、港股、美股的任意上市公司。
description_en: Secondary-market buy-side deep equity analysis skill. Use when the user asks for a deep, value, or fundamental analysis of a listed company. Core capabilities: (1) run a financial screen first and stop immediately if it fails; (2) if passed, analyze in order the business, growth potential, business model, competitive moat, corporate culture, organizational capability, and management capital allocation (reinvestment return versus capital allocation discipline); (3) finally systematically challenge the investment case from a contrarian risk standpoint. Evidence principle: only state as fact what is directly supported by evidence, and cite sources after each section. Covers A-share, HK, and US listed companies.
